description: Run a list of steps on a desktop capsule in ONE call, back to back; the run stops at the first step that fails. Prefer it over one call per step whenever you know what comes next. Each step is {do: verb, ...that verb's fields}: screen: click {x, y, button?, count?}, type {text}, key {keys: ['ctrl+s']}, move {x, y}, scroll {x, y, dx, dy}, drag {x1, y1, x2, y2, button?} or {path: [[x, y], ...], smooth?, closed?, stepMs?, button?} (a stroke through the points), screenshot {format?, scale?, x?, y?, w?, h?}, ui_tree, find_element {selector}, wait_element {selector, timeoutMs}, clipboard, clipboard_set {text}, windows, window_focus {title}, ocr; without coordinates: element {action, selector, value?, window?} (action set_value, clear, toggle, expand, collapse, invoke, select, focus or scroll_into_view), window {action, title | id, x?, y?, w?, h?} (minimize, maximize, restore, close, move, resize), open {target, kind?, waitMs?}, wait_for {condition, selector?, window?, text?, timeoutMs?, stableMs?} (present, absent, enabled, text, window, screen_stable; a wait that ends unmet fails the step), screen (its size, the pointer, the active window); browser: browser_open {url}, browser_navigate {url}, browser_snapshot, browser_click {ref | text | selector}, browser_fill {ref, value, submit?}, browser_select {ref, option}, browser_press {keys}, browser_scroll {dy}, browser_wait {text | ref, state?}, browser_text, browser_eval {expression}, browser_screenshot; commands and files: exec {cmd: [...], cwd?, timeoutSec?}, write_file {path, content}, read_file {path, maxBytes?} (a text file comes back as text); they also run while a person holds the screen; helpers: click_element {selector: {role?, name?, text?}, waitMs?} (find, waiting up to 5 s, then click its centre), say {text} (narrate for the person watching), pause {ms}; skills: use {procedure, skill?, version?, args?} (run a procedure of a skill from capsulate_skills with its args; the call's skill is the default), check {element: selector, present?} | {window: title} | {exec: [...], exitCode?, contains?} | {file, contains?} | {pixel: {x, y, color, tolerance?}} (with timeoutMs? it waits; a check that does not hold fails), pixel {x, y} (a pixel's colour), menus {window?} (every menu's items). A step can say frame: '<name>' to give its coordinates in a frame of the call's frames (screen = origin + scale * (x, y), a stroke clamped inside clamp), and save: {variable: resultField} to keep a result for later steps as {{variable}}. Any step can carry expect (a wait that must succeed after it: {selector, timeoutMs} after a screen step, {text | ref | selector, timeoutMs} after a browser step) and optional: true (may fail without stopping the run). observe returns a look at the end, also when the run stopped early: 'screenshot', 'ui_tree' or 'browser_snapshot'. At most 200 steps and 90 s per call. Never put passwords or other secrets in steps; hand those to the person (capsulate_handoff).

frames.description: Coordinate frames steps may name, e.g. {canvas: {origin: [346, 176], scale: 0.42, clamp: [[0, 0], [900, 1200]]}}

skill.description: The skill use steps call when they name none

do.description: The verb, e.g. click_element, type, key, browser_click

name: capsulate_run_actions
